<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10012026-10-1403-29-17" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> yang bden gnyis su | sangs rgyas la bden pa gnyis kyi yon tan gyis bstad pas | shugs la bden pa gnyis ston pa'i bstan chos rtsoM par du 'kha'o zhes bshad pa bzhin du | 'dir yang mkhyan pa gsuM gyi yon tan gyis bstod pas | shugs la mkhyen pa gsuM ston pa'i bstan chos tsaM par khas blangs pa yin te |
    
     <pb n="13a"/>

    <lb edRef="inst:4513" n="13a1"/>| bstan chos kyi don dang 'thun pa'i bstod pa yin ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
